name: Bill Watch
tagline: Surface the subscriptions and charges your inbox quietly forgot about
description: Bill Watch combs your inbox for money you have stopped tracking: recurring charges, free trials about to roll into paid plans, subscriptions gathering dust, and credits sitting unspent. It returns a read-only keep-or-cut rundown so you can decide what to cancel without handing over write access to anything.
author: DennisW_15
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
